churches.name: Brentwood Baptist Church (Houston)
churches.pastor: Dr. Joe Samuel Ratliff (Senior Pastor since 1980)
churches.denomination_detail: Southern Baptist Convention via the National African-American Fellowship of the SBC (NAAF) — Dr. Ratliff is the founding president of NAAF; also affiliated with Union Baptist Association (the largest urban SBC association in the US, where Ratliff was the first African-American to lead).

score_notes.gender: RED — Brentwood Baptist Houston has multiple ordained female ministers on pastoral staff: Rev. Mary A. Frazier (Minister of Youth & College since 2006), Rev. Barbara A. Thomas (Children & Events Coordinator, explicitly licensed and ordained). This is a direct BF&M 2000 Article VI nonconformity. Common in some Black SBC-affiliated congregations but technically grounds for SBC Credentials Committee review per the Saddleback / Fern Creek / Saddleback precedent.
score_notes.denominational: SBC affiliation legitimate via NAAF and Union Baptist Association, but female ordination practice creates BF&M2000 tension. Yellow rather than red on denominational because the church remains in formal cooperation despite the gender-policy gap.
score_notes.cultural: Site copy includes 'Social Justice Advocate' role (Dr. C. Clay Pickens) — verify whether DEI/CRT-adjacent or biblical justice framing.

review_flag.reason: Female ordained pastoral staff (Rev. Frazier, Rev. Thomas) at SBC-affiliated megachurch — should be referred to SBC Credentials Committee per Saddleback precedent.

churches.assessment: Brentwood Baptist Church Houston, led by Dr. Joe Samuel Ratliff since February 1980, grew from 500 members to 12,000 by 2000 (now ~7,000+ at two services). Dr. Ratliff is the founding president of the National African-American Fellowship of the SBC and was the first African-American to lead the Union Baptist Association (largest urban SBC body, 500+ churches). Theologically conservative on most matters (Christology, Scripture, soteriology) but ordains women to pastoral office (Rev. Mary A. Frazier as Minister of Youth & College; Rev. Barbara A. Thomas licensed and ordained Children & Events Coordinator) — direct BF&M 2000 Article VI violation. RED on gender; YELLOW overall with Credentials Committee referral flag.
